card.name: Words leading into stakes or consequences
card.fires_on: Words just before a statement of importance, harm, or risk, such as 'important' after 'many', 'they' before 'will vanish', or 'delaying' drug names before 'outweigh the risks'. It fires on the word right before the consequence is named.

modes.label: Importance adjectives
modes.description: Adjectives like 'important', 'valuable' or 'crucial' that stress how much something matters.
modes.example: improving the detection and monitoring of insecticide resistance in field populations of an<< important>> malaria-carrying mosquito.

modes.label: Risk-benefit drug phrasing
modes.description: The last piece of a drug name or verb in a sentence weighing delay or treatment against risk.
modes.example: at least 2 weeks prior to the first dose of EMPAVELI, unless the risks of delaying EMPAVEL<<I>> outweigh the risks of developing a serious infection

modes.label: Harm or loss wording
modes.description: Words that lead into harm, exposure or disappearance.
modes.example: Compulsive behaviors may result in harm<< to>> the patient and others if not

card.plain: It marks spots in a sentence where the text is about to say something matters or could go wrong.
